say:1:1732245401:1.text: Get your hands off me! Only my owner can touch me!
say:1:1732245401:1.source_cn: 不许摸喵！除了喵的主人没有人可以摸我！
say:1:1732245401:1.male: Get your hands off me! Only my owner can touch me!
say:1:1732245401:1.female: Get your hands off me! Only my owner can touch me!

say:2:1732245402:1.text: If you really want to pet me, you'll have to help me find my owner first!
say:2:1732245402:1.source_cn: 想要摸喵的话，就帮喵找找喵的主人吧！
say:2:1732245402:1.male: If you really want to pet me, you'll have to help me find my owner first!
say:2:1732245402:1.female: If you really want to pet me, you'll have to help me find my owner first!

say:3:1732245403:1.text: He hasn't been home since he went out. I'm worried about him. *Meow*...
say:3:1732245403:1.source_cn: 他出门之后一直没有回来，也不知道是怎么回事喵……
